# fnox_secret (Data Source)

Fetches a single secret from fnox via `fnox get`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fnox_secret" "db_password" {
  key = "DB_PASSWORD"
}

data "fnox_secret" "prod_api_key" {
  key     = "API_KEY"
  profile = "production"
}

resource "some_resource" "example" {
  password = data.fnox_secret.db_password.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The fnox secret key to retrieve.

### Optional

- `base64_decode` (Boolean) Base64-decode the secret value after retrieval (passes --base64-decode to fnox get).
- `profile` (String) fnox profile to use for this secret, overriding the provider-level default profile.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, equal to key.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The retrieved secret value.
